description:
Top-charting idol Lee Siwoo feels increasingly isolated as the people around him—his own staff and colleagues—start to avoid him. Desperate for somewhere to release his growing frustration, he finds himself once again seeking out his ex-boyfriend, Doyoon.

With Doyoon, Siwoo reveals the desires he’s kept buried from the world, using their encounters as a way to momentarily ease his stress and keep himself together.
But one day, when Siwoo overhears an absurd rumor about himself, the fragile balance between them begins to shift—changing their relationship in ways neither expected.
